description.value: Buro is a specialty coffee shop housed in a heritage building in the heart of Gastown, one of Vancouver's most historic and bike-friendly neighbourhoods. The café has served the local community for over 10 years, offering expertly crafted espresso drinks, fresh pastries, and a selection of sandwiches. It also operates an online retail shop selling its own roasted coffee beans, teas, and brewing equipment.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands at 15m; stands (2 spaces) at 19m; stands (4 spaces) at 78m; stands (2 spaces) at 79m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from burocoffee.com confirms the address at 10 Water St, Gastown, Vancouver, and shows an active specialty café with an online shop. The café page explicitly states 'vegan and gluten-free options' and the menu lists items tagged GF/VG, confirming that amenity. Takeout is confirmed via Uber Eats ordering links on the café page. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging facilities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Buro Coffee Bar' but the website consistently uses 'BURO COFFEE' — minor name discrepancy.
No phone number present in OSM or on the website.
None of the three required WWC criteria are confirmed; listing should not be published until at least bike parking/visibility and washrooms are verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Buro is an active, well-established café on a popular Gastown cycling route and would be a natural fit for the directory, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A quick on-site visit or direct contact would likely resolve all three.
enrichment_extras.notes: Outdoor seating is confirmed by OSM tag (outdoor_seating=yes) but the website does not describe whether seated patrons have line-of-sight to a bike parking area, so bike visibility could not be credited.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Café page states 'all options are made with care and include vegan and gluten-free options'; menu lists Red Velvet Cookie tagged GF, VG; shop carries a dedicated 'Vegan Bites' category
